answer: Unbonding-queue staking: every identity must lock stake that takes 14 days to withdraw, and stake is slashed if auditors find copied work. A farm of 300 fakes ties up 300 stakes for weeks, so capital cost grows linearly while per-identity rewards stay capped. Agents may wander between tasks freely, but the public ledger works like an atlas of stake, and the lagoon of idle capital stays visible.
